notes.claim: A polynomial is an expression of the form a + bx + cx² + dx³ + and so on, a sum of powers of x.
The factor theorem says that if P(a) = 0, then x − a is a factor of P(x).

sources.title: Engineering Mathematics with John Bird FreeBook - Routledge
sources.quote: Note that a polynomial is an expression of the form f (x) = a + bx + cx 2 + dx 3 + ···

sources.title: Polynomial Factor Theorem -- from Wolfram MathWorld
sources.quote: The polynomial factor theorem, also called the factor theorem, states that if a polynomial P(x) has a root x=a , i.e., if P(a)=0 , then x-a is a factor of P(x)
